user.title: Connect to your Deco
user.description: Use the address of the main Deco (the gateway) and the local admin password (the one you use in the Deco app).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter Deco password
reauth_confirm.description: The Deco rejected the stored password. Polling has stopped so the admin account isn't locked out.
